units.source_text: “这种贫困县，能做得出什么来呢……

en.t: What can a poor county like this possibly accomplish...

units.source_text: 我们呐，实在厌烦透顶了……

en.t: As for us, we are completely fed up...

units.source_text: 还是现在这样的做法最实惠……

en.t: The way we are doing it now is still the most practical...

units.source_text: 要是样样都靠政府那帮家伙，那么，在他们计较得失时，我们早就埋在沙之中……”

en.t: If we relied on those government people for everything, then while they were still weighing the gains and losses, we would already be buried in the sand...
